theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_cbm_im_median_minimizes
theorems.statement: ∀ (X : Type) [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) (u : X → ℝ) (β : ℝ), IsProbabilityMeasure μ → Integrable u μ → 1 / 2 ≤ μ.real {x | β ≤ u x} → 1 / 2 ≤ μ.real {x | u x ≤ β} → ∀ c : ℝ, ∫ x, |u x - β| ∂μ ≤ ∫ x, |u x - c| ∂μ
